intro.en: A Latin walking verb that gave English a small medical family.
intro.cn: 这是拉丁语「走」的动词，为英语留下了一小族医疗词。

latinIntro.en: The verb ambulare is the base of ambulance and its relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 动词 ambulare 是 ambulance 及其亲属词的词基。

items.meaning: a member of an ambulance crew

definition_zh: 愿意服从的；顺从的；经得起检验的；有义务服从的
definition_en: willing to agree, cooperate, or submit to authority; open to testing or control
core_image: 温和低头的人：别人一提建议就点头配合
scene: 新来的实习生脾气很好，什么安排都乐意接受。The new intern was amenable to every suggestion the manager made.
sceneCN: 这里的 amenable 是「愿意服从的、通情达理的」（第 1 个义项：乐于接受建议）；句意是这位新实习生对经理的每个建议都很乐意配合。

pos.zh: 愿服从的；通情达理的；肯合作的

derivatives.zh: 形容词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「顺从地；乐于配合地」
形容词加名词后缀 -ity 构成，义为「顺从性；可支配性」

senses.title: Willing to cooperate or agree
senses.titleCN: 愿意配合的：乐于点头答应
senses.definition: open and responsive to suggestion; willing to agree or cooperate
senses.definitionCN: 对建议持开放态度，愿意同意或配合
senses.example: The landlord proved amenable to lowering the rent.
senses.exampleCN: 房东愿意配合降低租金。
senses.why: The Latin root minare means to drive animals with threats; a tame animal is one you can lead, hence a person you can persuade.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 minare 意为「驱赶牲畜」，温驯的牲畜可以牵走，由此引申为可以被说服的人。

senses.title: Responsible to a legal authority
senses.titleCN: 法律上须服从的：受管辖
senses.definition: liable to be brought under the jurisdiction or authority of a court or law
senses.definitionCN: 应受法院或法律管辖的，负服从义务的
senses.example: Foreign diplomats are amenable to local traffic laws in most countries.
senses.exampleCN: 在多数国家，外交官也须遵守当地交通法规。
senses.why: If a person can be 'led' by the law, the same herding image becomes legal obligation.
senses.whyCN: 既然一个人能被法律「牵引」，驱赶牲畜的意象就变成了法律义务。

senses.title: Open to testing or analysis
senses.titleCN: 经得起检验的：可供研究处理
senses.definition: capable of being tested, analyzed, or dealt with by a method
senses.definitionCN: 能够用某种方法加以检验、分析或处理的
senses.example: The data were amenable to statistical analysis.
senses.exampleCN: 这些数据适合做统计分析。
senses.why: What willingly yields to a person also yields to a procedure; the word transfers to things.
senses.whyCN: 乐于向人让步的东西同样乐于向方法让步，词义由此转移到事物上。

senses.title: Responsive to medical treatment
senses.definition: responding favorably to medical treatment or therapy
senses.definitionCN: 对医疗或治疗产生良好反应的
senses.example: This cancer is highly amenable to radiation therapy.
senses.exampleCN: 这种癌症对放射治疗反应良好。
senses.why: Medicine borrowed the sense of yielding: a disease that 'obeys' treatment is amenable.
senses.whyCN: 医学借用了「顺服」之义：肯「听话」的疾病就是对治疗有反应的疾病。

senses.title: Easily guided in temperament
senses.definition: having a mild, tractable disposition that others can guide
senses.definitionCN: 性情温和、容易被他人引导的
senses.example: Puppies that are amenable are much easier to train.
senses.exampleCN: 性情温顺的幼犬训练起来容易得多。
senses.why: The original image of driving livestock stays closest to the surface when we describe an animal's temperament.
senses.whyCN: 描述动物性情时，「驱赶牲畜」的本源意象最为贴近字面。

senses.title: Subject to rules or conditions
senses.definition: subject or subordinate to rules, conditions, or procedures
senses.definitionCN: 受规则、条件或程序约束的
senses.example: Membership benefits are amenable to the club's regulations.
senses.exampleCN: 会员权益须遵守俱乐部章程。
senses.why: Anything placed under a system is, figuratively, being led along that system's track.
senses.whyCN: 凡被纳入某个体系的事物，形象地说都是沿着该体系的轨道被牵引前行。

intro.en: Amenable traces to Anglo-French and medieval Latin words about leading animals, ultimately a metaphor for being led.
intro.cn: amenable 源自盎格鲁-法语和中世纪拉丁语中「驱赶牲畜」的词，最终是「被牵引」的隐喻。

items.en: Root *mei-, to move or drive, source of Latin minare.
items.cn: 原始印欧语词根 *mei-「移动、驱赶」，是拉丁语 minare 的来源。

items.en: minare, to drive animals with cries or threats; minari, to threaten.
items.cn: 拉丁语 minare「以呼喝驱赶牲畜」；minari「威吓」。

items.en: aminare, to lead by threats; adjective aminabilis, liable to be led.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 aminare「以威吓牵引」，形容词 aminabilis「可被牵引的」。

items.en: amener, to lead or bring, from a- (to) plus mener (to lead).
items.cn: 盎格鲁-法语 amener「引领、带来」，由 a-（向）+ mener（引导）构成。

items.en: English amenable first meant liable to be brought to account, then willing to be led.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语 amenable 先指「应被追究责任」，后转为「愿意被引导」。

items.en: Now chiefly an agreeable, cooperative temperament or openness to treatment and analysis.
items.cn: 如今主要表示性格随和配合，或对治疗、分析持开放态度。

note.en: Do not confuse amenable with amendable or amenity; and pick near-synonyms carefully by register.
note.cn: 不要把 amenable 与 amendable、amenity 混淆；近义词也要按语域仔细区分。

entries.definition: able to be corrected or changed; from Latin emendare, not from minare.
entries.definitionCN: 可修正的、可修改的；源自拉丁语 emendare，与 amenable 词根不同，仅形近。

entries.definition: a pleasant feature or convenience; shares spelling start but a different branch of meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 便利设施、宜人之处；拼写开头相似但词义分支不同，注意区分。

entries.definition: friendly and pleasant in manner; from Latin amare, to love — a different root despite similar sound.
entries.definitionCN: 和蔼可亲的；源自拉丁语 amare「爱」，词根不同但读音相近，易混。

entries.definition: obeying rules or requests, sometimes with a hint of passivity.
entries.definitionCN: 顺从的、依从的，有时略带被动意味。

entries.definition: easily controlled or managed, like docile animals or solvable problems.
entries.definitionCN: 易驾驭的、易处理的，既可指温驯也可指问题易解。

entries.definition: willing to receive new ideas or suggestions.
entries.definitionCN: 乐于接受新想法或建议的。

normalIntro.en: Link amenable to being led without resistance.
normalIntro.cn: 把 amenable 联想为「不抵抗地被牵引」。

normal.en: a- (to) + men- (drive, lead): one who is led easily.
normal.cn: a-（向）+ men-（驱赶、引导）：容易被牵引的人。

normal.en: Same men- family: amenable, menace (threat used to drive), amenable to reason.
normal.cn: men- 词族：amenable（顺从的）、menace（用于驱赶的威吓）、服理。

normal.en: Picture a farmer leading a calm ox — amenable to the rope.
normal.cn: 想象农夫牵着一头安静的牛——对缰绳十分顺从。

normal.en: Common pattern: amenable to + noun (change, reason, treatment).
normal.cn: 常见搭配：amenable to + 名词（改变、道理、治疗）。

normal.en: Contrast: amendable = can be fixed; amenable = willing to follow.
normal.cn: 对比：amendable 是「可修改」，amenable 是「愿意服从」。

abstract.en: Imagine a door with no lock: it opens amenable to every knock.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇没上锁的门：谁来敲都乐意开，即「顺从配合」。

abstract.en: See a meeting where everyone nods; the whole room is amenable.
abstract.cn: 想象会议室里人人点头，全场都「乐于配合」。

abstract.en: Think of soft clay: amenable to every shape the sculptor wants.
abstract.cn: 想想柔软的陶泥：任凭雕塑家摆弄，即「易处理、顺从」。

examples.en: She is amenable to working weekends if the deadline requires it.
examples.cn: 如果截止日期需要，她愿意周末加班。

examples.en: The dispute was finally resolved because both sides were amenable to mediation.
examples.cn: 双方都愿意接受调解，争端最终得到解决。

examples.en: Early-stage illness is far more amenable to treatment.
examples.cn: 早期疾病对治疗的反应要好得多。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿妹闹不」——阿妹一点也不闹，别人说什么都是「不闹、都行」，特别顺从好说话。

root: 一般认为源自拉丁语 minare（驱赶牲畜）→ 中世纪拉丁语 aminabilis（可被牵引的）→ 盎格鲁-法语 amener（带来），进入英语后由「应被追究」转为「愿意被引导」，词根属「牵引」意象，词源链条中段存在重构成分。

sensesIntro.en: From the image of a tractable animal being led, amenable extends to legal obedience, workable data, and treatable illness.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「温驯牲畜被牵引」的意象出发，amenable 扩展到法律服从、数据可分析、疾病可治疗等用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a calm animal that lets itself be led
core.cn: 核心意象：甘愿被牵引的温驯牲畜

branches.en: Agreeable temperament, in people and animals
branches.cn: 人与动物温顺配合的性情

branches.en: Falling under legal or institutional authority
branches.cn: 受法律或机构权威管辖

branches.en: Problems and data that yield to analysis
branches.cn: 可被分析方法处理的问题与数据

branches.en: Diseases that respond to therapy
Things bound by rules and conditions
branches.cn: 受规则条件约束的事物

intro.cn: amensible 由方向前缀、「驱赶」词根和表示能力的形容词后缀组合而成。

latinIntro.en: The root family spreads through words of threat and leading.
latinIntro.cn: 该词族散布于表示威吓与引导的词汇中。

definition_zh: 便利设施；舒适宜人的环境；愉快；（amenities）礼节
definition_en: a desirable or useful feature of a place; pleasantness; courtesies of social life
core_image: 酒店大堂那张舒服的沙发和免费的咖啡角：让日子过得舒服的小东西
scene: 新建的公寓楼下有健身房、花园和全天便利店。The building offers every modern amenity a resident could want.
sceneCN: 这里的 amenity 是「便利设施」（第 1 个义项：提高生活舒适度的设施）；句意是这栋楼提供住户想要的各种现代化便利设施。

derivatives.zh: 复数形式，常指成套的便利设施或社交礼节
同源近族词（词源关系存疑），义为「顺从的；乐于配合的」，注意区分

senses.title: A useful or pleasant feature of a place
senses.titleCN: 便利设施：让生活舒适方便的配置
senses.definition: a feature of a building or place that makes life there easier or more pleasant
senses.definitionCN: 建筑物或场所中使生活更方便舒适的配置
senses.example: The apartment complex includes a pool and other amenities.
senses.exampleCN: 这个公寓小区配有游泳池等便利设施。
senses.why: From the idea of pleasantness, real estate narrowed the word to the things that supply it.
senses.whyCN: 从「宜人」这个抽象概念出发，房地产行业把这个词具体化为提供舒适感的各种设施。

senses.title: The pleasant quality of a place or climate
senses.titleCN: 宜人：环境或气候的舒适特质
senses.definition: the pleasantness or attractiveness of surroundings or weather
senses.definitionCN: 环境或天气的舒适宜人之处
senses.example: Visitors praise the amenity of the coastal climate.
senses.exampleCN: 游客称赞沿海气候的宜人。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: the quality itself before any object supplying it.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：先有「宜人」这种性质，才有提供这种性质的物件。

senses.title: Pleasant social relations
senses.titleCN: 社交融洽：人际间的和乐
senses.definition: the pleasant quality of social interaction among people
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间交往的和乐融洽
senses.example: Office amenity improved once the managers stopped shouting.
senses.exampleCN: 经理们不再吼叫后，办公室气氛融洽多了。
senses.why: Pleasantness of place extends naturally to pleasantness among the people in it.
senses.whyCN: 场所的宜人很自然地延伸为场所中人与人相处的宜人。

senses.title: Courtesies and polite conventions
senses.titleCN: 社交礼节：复数形式的客套规范
senses.definition: in the plural, the polite conventions observed in social or diplomatic life
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式，指社交或外交场合遵循的客套礼节
senses.example: Despite the dispute, the two delegations observed the amenities.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管有分歧，两个代表团仍遵守外交礼节。
senses.why: Politeness is pleasantness maintained between strangers, so the word covers its rituals.
senses.whyCN: 礼貌就是陌生人之间维持的「宜人」，于是礼节也被这个词覆盖。

senses.title: Small complimentary items of comfort
senses.titleCN: 免费小用品：酒店洗漱包等
senses.definition: small complimentary items provided for comfort, such as toiletries in hotels
senses.definitionCN: 为舒适而提供的免费小物件，如酒店洗漱用品
senses.example: The room came with towels and complimentary amenities.
senses.exampleCN: 房间配有毛巾和免费洗漱用品。
senses.why: The hospitality industry shrank the broad sense to the tangible giveaways guests take home.
senses.whyCN: 酒店业把宽泛的「设施」义缩小到客人能带走的实物赠品上。

senses.title: Legal comfort interests in land
senses.titleCN: 法律上的环境舒适利益
senses.definition: in property law, the non-material benefits of land such as views or quiet
senses.definitionCN: 财产法中土地的非实体利益，如景观、安静
senses.example: The court weighed the loss of amenity caused by the new highway.
senses.exampleCN: 法院权衡了新高速公路造成的环境舒适损失。
senses.why: Law needs a word for comfort that has no price tag but has value.
senses.whyCN: 法律需要一个词指称那些没有标价却有价值的舒适利益。

intro.en: Amenity comes through Old French from Latin comitas-related roots of pleasantness; its link to amare, to love, is generally assumed.
intro.cn: amenity 经古法语来自拉丁语表示「宜人」的词，一般认为与表示「爱」的 amare 词根相关（关系存疑）。

items.en: amaenitas, pleasantness or charm, generally connected with amoenus, pleasing.
items.cn: 拉丁语 amaenitas「宜人、魅力」，一般与 amoenus「令人愉悦的」相关。

items.en: amoenus may derive from amare, to love, though some scholars prefer an older Mediterranean word.
items.cn: amoenus 可能源自 amare「爱」，也有学者认为来自更古老的地中海语词（存疑）。

items.en: amenite, pleasantness, borrowed from Latin learned vocabulary.
items.cn: 古法语 amenite「宜人」，借自拉丁书面语。

items.en: English amenity first meant pleasantness of place or manner.
items.cn: 十五世纪英语 amenity 首先表示地点或举止的宜人。

items.en: The plural amenities widened to social courtesies, then to convenient facilities.
items.cn: 十八、十九世纪复数 amenities 先扩为社交礼节，再转为便利设施。

items.en: Now the standard word for comfort features in real estate, hotels, and urban planning.
items.cn: 如今是房地产、酒店与城市规划中表示舒适设施的标准用词。

note.en: Separate amenity from its look-alike amenable and from rival words for comfort and convenience.
note.cn: 把 amenity 与形近词 amenable 区分开，也要与表示舒适便利的近义词区分。

entries.definition: willing to cooperate; a different root despite the shared opening letters.
entries.definitionCN: 顺从配合的；与 amenity 开头拼写相近但词根不同。

entries.definition: friendly in manner; from Latin amare, to love.
entries.definitionCN: 和蔼可亲的；源自拉丁语 amare「爱」。

entries.definition: rhyming abstract noun of -ity; dignity is worth, amenity is comfort.
entries.definitionCN: 同韵 -ity 抽象名词：dignity 是尊严，amenity 是舒适。

entries.definition: a space or equipment serving a function; more functional, less cozy.
entries.definitionCN: 设施、场所；偏功能性，少了「舒适」意味。

entries.definition: ease of use or access; stresses saving effort.
physical ease and wellbeing; broader than a single feature.
entries.definitionCN: 舒适；泛指身心安适，范围比单一设施更宽。

normalIntro.en: Tie amenity to the pleasant little extras that make life easy.
normalIntro.cn: 把 amenity 和那些让生活舒服的小配置绑在一起记。

normal.en: amoenus (pleasing) + -ity (noun suffix): the state of being pleasing.
normal.cn: amoenus（令人愉悦的）+ -ity（名词后缀）：愉悦的属性。

normal.en: Plural rule: amenities almost always appear in real-estate ads.
normal.cn: 复数规律：amenities 几乎总出现在房产广告里。

normal.en: Same -ity family: dignity, facility, amenity — abstract qualities.
normal.cn: 同类 -ity 词：dignity（尊严）、facility（设施）、amenity（舒适）。

normal.en: observe the amenities = mind your social manners.
normal.cn: observe the amenities 即「讲社交礼节」。

normal.en: Hotel corridor memory: free shampoo, pool, gym — all amenities.
normal.cn: 酒店走廊记忆法：免费洗发水、泳池、健身房——全是 amenities。

abstract.en: Picture a lobby with a fireplace; the warmth you feel is the amenity.
abstract.cn: 想象带壁炉的大堂，你感到的那份暖意就是 amenity。

abstract.en: Amenity starts like 'a moment of ease' — a little break life hands you.
abstract.cn: amenity 开头读着像「a moment of ease」——生活送你的一小段安逸。

abstract.en: Think of a picnic table under shade trees: comfort built into a place.
abstract.cn: 想象树荫下的野餐桌——被「种」进场所里的舒适。

examples.en: The hotel lists its amenities on the booking page.
examples.cn: 酒店在预订页面列出各项设施。

examples.en: Lack of basic amenities made the village hard to live in.
examples.cn: 缺乏基本生活设施让这个村子难以居住。

examples.en: Both sides observed the amenities before the tough negotiation began.
examples.cn: 艰难谈判开始前，双方都讲究礼节寒暄了一番。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿妹捏提」——阿妹一进酒店就捏着托盘提来一堆免费小用品，全是便利设施。

root: 一般认为源自拉丁语 amaenitas（宜人），与 amoenus（令人愉悦的）相关，更早可能出自 amare（爱），但 amoenus 的更深层来源存在学术争议，宜存疑处理。

sensesIntro.en: Amenity runs from the abstract pleasantness of a climate down to hotel shampoo bottles and up to legal comfort interests.
sensesIntro.cn: amenity 上可指气候环境的宜人，下可指酒店免费用品，还进入法律指土地的舒适利益。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: comfort quietly built into a place
core.cn: 核心意象：悄悄安放在场所里的舒适

branches.en: Tangible comfort features and giveaway items
branches.cn: 实体设施与免费舒适小物

Harmony among people sharing a place
The polite rituals that keep interaction pleasant

branches.cn: 被法律承认有价值的舒适利益

intro.en: Amenity is a Latin abstract noun ending in -ity, naming the quality of being pleasing.
intro.cn: amenity 是以 -ity 结尾的拉丁式抽象名词，表示「令人愉悦」这一性质。

latinIntro.en: The -itas family of Latin supplies English with hundreds of -ity nouns.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 -itas 词族为英语提供了数百个 -ity 名词。

items.example: the sports facility opened in May
she faced the loss with dignity

items.meaning: mild weather; adjectival parallel of the amenity sense
items.meaningCN: 宜人的气候；与 amenity 第 2 义平行
items.example: they moved south for the amiable climate
items.exampleCN: 他们为宜人气候搬去了南方
当地人的好客令游客难忘

items.example: the story lost plausibility under questioning
items.exampleCN: 这个故事在盘问下显得不可信了

definition_zh: n. 氨；氨气；氨水（家用清洁剂）
definition_en: A colourless gas of nitrogen and hydrogen with a sharp smell, used in fertilisers and industry; its water solution is also called ammonia and used as a cleaner.
core_image: 一开盖就冲鼻子的那股刺鼻气味
scene: 她戴上手套才敢擦那面油腻的灶台。The cleaner contains ammonia, so open a window first.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：这里的 ammonia 指含氨的清洁液，气味刺鼻，所以要先开窗通风。

senses.title: The gas and industrial chemical
senses.definition: a colourless gas of nitrogen and hydrogen with a sharp smell, made in bulk for fertilisers and refrigeration
senses.definitionCN: 由氮与氢构成、气味刺鼻的无色气体，大规模生产用于化肥与制冷
senses.example: The plant produces ammonia for fertiliser factories.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂为化肥厂生产氨。
senses.why: The name comes from sal ammoniac, a salt scraped near a desert shrine, so the word carries a place name into modern industry.
senses.whyCN: 名称来自 sal ammoniac「阿蒙神之盐」，那是在沙漠神殿附近刮取的盐，因此这个词把一个地名带进了现代工业。

senses.title: The household cleaner
senses.definition: a water solution of that gas, sold for cutting grease on glass and hard surfaces
senses.definitionCN: 该气体的水溶液，作为清除玻璃与硬表面油污的清洁剂出售
senses.example: Never mix ammonia with bleach in the same bucket.
senses.exampleCN: 绝不要把氨水与漂白剂混在同一只桶里。
senses.why: The same substance is meant, but the household sense names the bottle on the shelf rather than the molecule in the plant.
senses.whyCN: 指的是同一种物质，但家用义命指的是架子上的那瓶液体，而不是工厂里的分子。

intro.en: Ammonia is shortened from sal ammoniac, the salt of Ammon, collected near the desert shrine of the god Amun. Chemists kept the place name when they isolated the gas.
intro.cn: ammonia 由 sal ammoniac「阿蒙神之盐」缩略而来，那种盐是在阿蒙神的沙漠神殿附近采集的。化学家分离出这种气体时保留了那个地名。

items.en: The name Ammon comes from Greek Ammon, the Egyptian god Amun, whose desert shrine in Libya stood near deposits of a peculiar salt.
items.cn: Ammon 这个名字来自希腊语 Ammon，即埃及神阿蒙；他在利比亚的沙漠神殿附近有一种特殊盐的沉积。

items.en: Latin sal ammoniacus meant salt of Ammon, a crusty salt gathered from the ground near that shrine and used in medicine and metalwork.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sal ammoniacus 意为「阿蒙神之盐」，是在那座神殿附近地面采集的结壳盐，用于医药与金属加工。

items.en: Eighteenth-century chemists shortened sal ammoniac to ammonia once the gas had been isolated from that salt and recognised as a distinct substance.
items.cn: 18 世纪的化学家在从那种盐中分离出气体、并确认它是独立物质后，把 sal ammoniac 缩略为 ammonia。

items.en: English took ammonia in the late eighteenth century, first for the gas and soon for the watery solution sold as a household cleaner.
items.cn: 英语在 18 世纪后期借入 ammonia，先指气体，很快也指作为家用清洁剂出售的水溶液。

items.en: Ammonia now names a bulk industrial chemical, and the same base gives ammonium for the ion and amine for the wider family of compounds.
items.cn: ammonia 如今指一种大宗工业化学品，同一底座还产生表示离子的 ammonium 与表示更大家族化合物的 amine。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the ammon- family and one similar opening; the near-meaning group lists other harsh cleaning chemicals.
note.cn: 形近组保留 ammon- 词族与一个相近开头；近义组列出其他刺激性清洁化学品。

A compound derived from ammonia.
entries.definitionCN: 由氨衍生的一类化合物。

entries.definition: Containing or like ammonia.
Loss of memory.
A strong alkaline solution used for cleaning.
entries.definitionCN: 用于清洁的强碱性溶液。

entries.definition: A chemical that removes colour and stains.
entries.definitionCN: 去除颜色与污渍的化学品。

entries.definition: A substance that burns organic tissue.
entries.definitionCN: 能烧伤有机组织的物质。

entries.definition: A liquid that dissolves other substances.
entries.definitionCN: 能溶解其他物质的液体。

normalIntro.en: Ammonia is the salt of Ammon shortened, so link the sharp smell to a desert shrine.
normalIntro.cn: ammonia 是「阿蒙神之盐」的缩略，所以把那股刺鼻气味与一座沙漠神殿联系起来。

normal.en: Ammonia is the gas and the bottle; ammonium is the ion.
normal.cn: ammonia 是气体也是那瓶液体，ammonium 是离子。

normal.en: It is uncountable: some ammonia, not an ammonia.
normal.cn: 它不可数：some ammonia，不说 an ammonia。

normal.en: Never mix ammonia with bleach; the fumes are dangerous.
normal.cn: 绝不要把氨水与漂白剂混合，产生的气体有毒。

normal.en: The smell is sharp and stinging, not sweet.
normal.cn: 气味刺鼻蛰人，不是甜的。

normal.en: Do not confuse ammonia with amnesia, loss of memory.
normal.cn: 别把 ammonia 与 amnesia「记忆丧失」混淆。

abstract.en: Picture a bottle that makes your eyes water before you touch it.
abstract.cn: 想象一瓶还没碰到就让你眼睛发酸的液体。

abstract.en: Imagine a white crust scraped from desert ground.
abstract.cn: 想象从沙漠地面刮下的一层白壳。

abstract.en: Think of a fertiliser plant breathing out a sharp cloud.
abstract.cn: 想象一家化肥厂呼出一团刺鼻的雾。

examples.en: Ammonia is made from nitrogen and hydrogen under pressure.
examples.cn: 氨由氮与氢在加压条件下合成。

examples.en: The ammonia smell told us the tank was leaking.
examples.cn: 那股氨味告诉我们储罐在泄漏。

examples.en: She diluted the ammonia before wiping the glass.
examples.cn: 她把氨水稀释后再擦玻璃。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「阿摩尼亚」——阿摩（ammo）尼亚（nia）：一摩（摸）就「你呀」地叫起来，那股冲鼻子的味道就是氨。

root: 埃及神阿蒙之名经希腊语 Ammon 进入拉丁语 sal ammoniacus「阿蒙神之盐」，18 世纪化学家缩略为 ammonia 指从该盐分离出的气体，再引申指家用氨水。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses are one substance in two places: the molecule made in a plant, and the bottle kept under a sink.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项是同一种物质的两个所在：工厂里造出的分子，以及水槽下放着的那瓶液体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sharp smell that rushes at your nose
core.cn: 核心意象：一开盖就冲鼻子的那股刺鼻气味

branches.en: A plant making fertiliser feedstock.
branches.cn: 一家生产化肥原料的工厂。

branches.en: A leaking tank in a cold store.
A bottle under the kitchen sink.
branches.cn: 厨房水槽下的一瓶清洁剂。

branches.en: A window opened before wiping grease.
One molecule, industrial then domestic.
branches.cn: 同一种分子，先工业用，再家用。

intro.en: Ammonia keeps the name root ammon- plus the substance ending -ia, and shifts to -ium for the ion.
intro.cn: ammonia 保留名称词根 ammon- 加物质词尾 -ia，变成离子时改用 -ium。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is sal ammoniacus, salt of Ammon; New Latin cut it to ammonia, and chemistry added ammonium.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语层次是 sal ammoniacus「阿蒙神之盐」；新拉丁语把它缩略为 ammonia，化学又加上 ammonium。

latinEntries.example: Sal ammoniacus is the old name.
New Latin cut the phrase short.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 新拉丁语把该短语缩略。
